name: php.remove
description: Remove one PHP version from an apt host, only if nothing uses it. At execution time it refuses if the version's FPM service is active or enabled, a web server config references it, the php alternative points at it, a cron, supervisor or systemd file names it, or purging would remove any other package. It then backs up the config and exact package list under /var/backups/php-remove and purges the packages.
health_check: The helper confirms with dpkg that the packages are gone.
